why: The OVER-triggering half of the selector, which `storage-namespace-never-selects-developer` deliberately cannot see. This is the more damaging direction of the two: an ordinary URL would start persisting into `tanks.dev.*`, so the player's campaign, stats and achievements would still be on disk but invisible to the game -- indistinguishable from a wiped save, and silent. Killed by the production rows of selectStorageNamespace's table and by the `dev` GATE case, none of which the under-triggering entry reaches.
killedBy: selectStorageNamespace is the `dev` GATE, not any individual flag
selectStorageNamespace reads '' as the production namespace
selectStorageNamespace reads '?dev=0' as the production namespace
selectStorageNamespace reads '?level=2' as the production namespace
